control_group_note: Initial cosine/no-adaptation reimplementation differed from legacy by <=1.721e-14 rad at identical states but produced divergent contact rollouts. This is not improvement evidence. Final version delegates directly to legacy and exact state parity passes. Contact-enabled and quintic implementations unchanged.
limitations: Simulator contact truth; no hardware estimator or hardware validation.
Selected on these trials; validation is not an independent multi-seed success-rate estimate.
Original acceptance unchanged: actual joint speed <=10 rad/s, heading <25 deg, goal >=0.72m and all remaining checks.
